about: Hunter step 1's birds, in the live Hunter areas they are snared in: crimson swifts and tropical wagtails in the Feldip Hunter area, golden warblers in the Uzer Hunter area, copper longtails in the Piscatoris Hunter area and cerulean twitches in the Rellekka Hunter area (its upper ledges among them). Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022). Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: the same birds' other homes (Isle of Souls, Kebos, Dognose Island, Varlamore, Kourend woodland) and the Digsite's honey buzzards.
